propositions: Natural fold operation retires and cites orphaned events without applying their effects, permanently losing repairable damage after the fold crosses the compaction threshold
Fold enumeration must exclude un-cited pre-snapshot events from both retirement and source_event_uuids citation, leaving orphans live so fsck detection and repair windows survive indefinitely
Fold candidates that are pre-snapshot events must be deferred until their governing snapshot itself is foldable to prevent silent burial of orphans under a new pre-snapshot snapshot
fsck --repair-snapshots must apply the same _AUTO_RECOVER vs _HUMAN_TRIAGE routing as fsck --repair to prevent unconditional rebuild that bypasses type-based repair classification
Shared orphan predicate (is_snapshot_orphan) must be extracted and reused between compact_txn and fsck_scan so the two repair doors cannot disagree on orphan classification
